nodes.label: Single in-portal feedback capture surface
Stamp 'prompted' on dialog open, not on submit
Form is cleared only after a successful send so a failed insert never eats the typed paragraph
Clipboard paste-to-attach because screenshots land on the clipboard, not on disk
page_path stays a clean route; entry source rides its own column so GROUP BY on page still works
Category colours applied as inline styles to avoid Tailwind arbitrary-value safelisting
'Your feedback' history view closes the loop so operators do not submit twice then give up
Screenshot PII caution: attachments are visible to the Drive247 team
Force-show-feedback-on-next-login campaign
Suppressed while a hard gate owns the screen: two Radix focus traps trap the operator
firedRef guards once-per-mount because the App Router dashboard layout survives every navigation
Deliberately not a gate: dismissible dialog over a fully usable dashboard
shouldForcePrompt - the unit-tested force-prompt decision rule
tenant_feedback_settings table (form_enabled, force_login_triggered_at)
Traffic fine / penalty intake with evidence attachments
Every fine also writes a Fine/Charge ledger entry so it lands in the customer balance
FINE-{fine.id} ledger reference string is the only link between a fine and its ledger row
Storage key sanitisation: macOS screenshot names carry U+202F which Storage rejects as 'Invalid key'
Creating a fine never charges the customer - charging is an explicit second action
Tenant-scoped customer -> rental -> vehicle/reg cascade for fine attribution
issue_date/due_date hand-formatted to local YYYY-MM-DD to keep date-only columns off UTC
Record the operator's payment of a fine to the issuing authority
Authority payments feed profit & loss - pl-summary and vehicle-pl caches are invalidated with the fine
record-authority-payment edge function
Bulk charge selected fines by fanning apply-fine out per fine
Bulk waive: client-side ledger deletion by FINE- reference, then apply-fine waive
Email toll statement plus a Stripe pay-link for a batch of unpaid fines
One email + one Stripe link means one customer and one rental, so settlement rides the proven generic webhook with no webhook change
Every billable fine must match the first fine's non-null ids - a filter(Boolean) Set would let a rental_id=null fine read as 'one rental'
24h live-pay-link check blocks a second payable link so the customer cannot pay the same tolls twice
targetCategories:['Fine'] tells the Stripe webhook to settle the link against the customer's Fine ledger charges
apply-fine edge function (charge / waive a fine)
create-checkout-session edge function
send-toll-report edge function (branded toll statement email)
Fine appeal / waiver resolution
Successful appeal voids the unpaid remainder and issues an unapplied customer credit for the already-paid portion
Appeal/waive rewrites ledger_entries straight from the browser (negative Adjustment + remaining_amount=0) with no edge function
Fine list filters mirrored into the URL query string so views are shareable and survive reload
Range dates normalised to local noon before serialising, dodging the timezone day-shift on date-only columns
Fines KPI tiles: open count, outstanding amount, due-this-week, overdue
Every tenant fine row is pulled to the browser and aggregated in JS rather than by a SQL aggregate or RPC
Reusable evidence dropzone with per-file preview, size/type rejection and dedupe-by-name
Convention: destructive/financial dialogs audit-log that the warning was SHOWN, not only that the action ran
Operator installment-plan console for a rental (schedule, activity, controls)
Slot 1 displays installment_plans.upfront_amount so rental detail, customer view and the new-rental preview all show the same day-zero number
Synthetic number=0 calendar tile when charge_first_upfront is off - not a scheduled_installments row, so it is never payable
Only the manual Record-Payment path settles locally; Stripe paths are settled by the webhook, flipping here would be a false positive
created_at DESC LIMIT 1 on payments picks the row just inserted - a sub-second race window accepted by design
Installment settlement deliberately mirrors the PAYG contract (payg_settle_invoice / PaygSection / onPay(accrualId))
Plan lifecycle controls: operator-triggered reminder, pause/resume, cancel
Auto vs manual collection mode drives the overdue banner copy (cron retry with 24h cooldown vs record-on-settle)
send-installment-reminders edge function
installment_settle_invoice - Postgres RPC that settles a payment against a scheduled installment
Installment schedule table (operator and customer variants of the same grid)
Pay is disabled before the due date - early collection would trigger cumulative PAYG-style supersession or leave the schedule out of order
Cron only evaluates open vs paid; 'Overdue Nd' and 'Due today' are presentation-only labels derived from the date
Customers get no Pay button in the table - their path is the banner button plus calendar click into the magic-link page
Calendar tiles are clickable only in open / due_today / overdue states, matching the table's disabled-Pay rule
Month grid built entirely in UTC with a Monday-first shift, so tiles cannot drift a day across timezones
Rental total decomposed into paid-upfront lines and the splittable amount rendered as N x installment
Each installment component redefines its own Intl currency formatter instead of using lib/format-utils like the rest of the portal
Live progress and result of AI verification of an uploaded insurance certificate
Scan status is polled every 1.5s rather than subscribed via Supabase Realtime
Three-way AI triage: auto_approved / auto_rejected / pending_review, plus a fraud-risk >= 0.5 flag
A failed scan never blocks the operator - 'you can still proceed'
Attach or detach an insurance verification from an Active/Pending rental
Customer picker used when creating an insurance policy
Customer search neither filters on tenant_id nor keys its cache by tenant - isolation rests entirely on RLS
Attach typed supporting documents to an insurance policy
Rental-first Bonzah insurance issuance: pick a rental, then run the standard buy/coverage flow
Inspection / Registration due-status chip (ok, due soon, overdue, missing)
UK MOT / road-tax domain renamed to US 'Inspection' / 'Registration' at the UI layer while the util stays mot-tax-utils
Inline Tesla brand mark SVG for vehicle badging
